FROM meeting WHERE label IS NOT NULL ), mem AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, pk.pack_id AS pack_id FROM (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) e JOIN dk ON dk.k = e.cr JOIN pk ON pk.k = e.pack_id ), mods AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, e.section_id AS section_id FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) e JOIN dk ON dk.k = e.cr ), disp AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, d.code AS code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id) AS wg_meeting FROM disposition d JOIN dk ON dk.k = d.target JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN mk ON mk.k = r.meeting_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = mk.meeting_id WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(d.evidence_status),'_',''),'-',''),' ','')) IN ('sourceverified','verifiedsource','verifiedfromsource') AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg),'_',''),'-',''),' ','')) IN ('ran5','r5','ranwg5','tsgranwg5','wg5') ), P AS ( SELECT id AS pack_id, tsg_number AS tn FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-240961' OR id = 'RP-240961' ), base AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.spec AS spec, s.release AS rel, s.clause AS clause, P.tn AS tn FROM P JOIN mem ON mem.pack_id = P.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = mem.doc_id JOIN mods ON mods.doc_id = doc.id JOIN section s ON s.id = mods.section_id WHERE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(s.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') = LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(doc.target_release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp WHERE disp.doc_id = doc.id) ), cand AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.spec AS spec, b.rel AS rel, b.clause AS clause, b.tn AS tn, COALESCE(cp.pack_number, cp.id) AS pack_number, cp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, cp.tsg_number AS ptn FROM base b JOIN section s2 cp.id = me2.pack_id WHERE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(d2.target_release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') = LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(s2.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') AND cp.tsg_number < b.tn ) SELECT DISTINCT c.spec AS specification, c.clause AS clause, WITH
docref AS (
  SELECT id AS ref, id AS doc_id FROM document WHERE id IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT number AS ref, id AS doc_id FROM document WHERE number IS NOT NULL
),
packref AS (
  SELECT id AS ref, id AS pack_id FROM cr_pack WHERE id IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT pack_number AS ref, id AS pack_id FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number IS NOT NULL
),
inpack AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.doc_id AS doc_id, pr.pack_id AS pack_id
  FROM (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) e
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = e.cr
  JOIN packref pr ON pr.ref = e.pack_id
),
modsec AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.doc_id AS doc_id, e.section_id AS section_id
  FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
        UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) e
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = e.cr
),
mods AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ms.doc_id AS doc_id, s.spec AS spec, s.clause AS clause,
         CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(s.release),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),'_','')) AS INTEGER) AS rel
  FROM modsec ms
  JOIN document d ON d.id = ms.doc_id
  JOIN section s ON s.id = ms.section_id
  WHERE CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(s.release),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),'_','')) AS INTEGER) = CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(d.target_release),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),'_','')) AS INTEGER)
),
verified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.doc_id AS doc_id, dp.code AS code, m.label AS wg_meeting
  FROM disposition dp
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = dp.target
  JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting m ON (m.id = r.meeting_id OR m.label = r.meeting_id)
  WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.evidence_status),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) IN ('sourceverified','verifiedsource')
    AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.scope),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) IN ('wholedocument','document','whole','fulldocument','entiredocument','doc','wholedoc','tdoc','wholetdoc','entiretdoc','fulltdoc')
    AND (UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) IN ('RAN3','R3','RANWG3','TSGRANWG3','WG3','3','RAN3WG') OR (m.wg IS NULL AND (m.label LIKE 'R3%' OR m.label LIKE '%RAN3%' OR m.label LIKE '%RAN_WG3%')))
),
xdocs AS (
  SELECT id AS doc_id FROM document WHERE number = 'R3-260655' OR id = 'R3-260655'
),
xclauses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.spec AS spec, s.clause AS clause, CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(s.release),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),'_','')) AS INTEGER) AS rel
  FROM modsec ms
  JOIN section s ON s.id = ms.section_id
  WHERE ms.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM xdocs)
    AND CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(s.release),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),'_','')) AS INTEGER) = 19
)
SELECT DISTINCT x.clause AS clause, COALESCE(o.number, o.id) AS document,
       v.code AS disposition, v.wg_meeting AS wg_meeting, cp.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM xclauses x
JOIN mods m ON m.spec = x.spec AND m.clause = x.clause AND m.rel = x.rel
JOIN document o ON o.id = m.doc_id
JOIN verified v ON v.doc_id = o.id
JOIN inpack ip ON ip.doc_id = o.id
JOIN cr_pack cp ON cp.id = ip.pack_id
WHERE o.id NOT IN (SELECT doc_id FROM xdocs)
  AND COALESCE(o.number, '') <> 'R3-260655'

docmap AS (SELECT id AS doc_id, id AS k FROM document UNION SELECT id AS doc_id, number AS k FROM document WHERE number IS NOT NULL),
packmap AS (SELECT id AS pack_id, id AS k FROM cr_pack UNION SELECT id AS pack_id, pack_number AS k FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number IS NOT NULL),
meetmap AS (SELECT id AS k, COALESCE(label, id) AS label, wg FROM meeting UNION SELECT label AS k, COALESCE(label, id) AS label, wg FROM meeting WHERE label IS NOT NULL),
sec AS (SELECT id, spec, clause, (CASE WHEN instr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim("release")),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_',''),'.')>0 THEN substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim("release")),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_',''),1,instr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim("release")),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_',''),'.')-1) ELSE replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim("release")),'release',''),'rel',''),'r',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_','') END) AS rel FROM section),
modraw AS (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by),
mods AS (SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc_id AS doc_id, mr.section_id AS section_id FROM modraw mr JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = mr.cr),
packraw AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member),
inpack AS (SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc_id AS doc_id, pm.pack_id AS pack_id FROM packraw pr JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = pr.cr JOIN packmap pm ON pm.k = pr.pack_id),
okdisp AS (SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc_id AS doc_id, dp.code AS code, mm.label AS wg_meeting FROM disposition dp JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = dp.target JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meetmap mm ON mm.k = r.meeting_id WHERE lower(replace(replace(replace(trim(dp.evidence_status),'_',''),' ',''),'-','')) IN ('sourceverified','verifiedsource') AND lower(replace(replace(replace(trim(dp.scope),'_',''),' ',''),'-','')) IN ('wholedocument','document','whole','fulldocument','entiredocument','doc','wholedoc','tdoc','wholetdoc','full') AND (upper(replace(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(mm.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) IN ('RAN2','R2','RANWG2','TSGRANWG2','WG2','TSGR2','RWG2') OR upper(replace(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(mm.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) LIKE 'RAN2%')),
P AS (SELECT id, tsg_number FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-201163' OR id = 'RP-201163'),
pcr AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.id AS doc_id, d.num AS num, d.rel AS rel, P.tsg_number AS ptsg FROM P JOIN inpack ip ON ip.pack_id = P.id JOIN docs d ON d.id = ip.doc_id WHERE d.id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM okdisp) AND d.rel IN ('15','16')),
pcl AS (SELECT DISTINCT pc.num AS document, s.spec AS spec, s.rel AS rel, s.clause AS clause, pc.ptsg AS ptsg FROM pcr pc JOIN mods mo ON mo.doc_id = pc.doc_id JOIN sec s ON s.id = mo.section_id WHERE s.rel = pc.rel)
SELECT DISTINCT pc.document AS document, pc.spec AS specification, pc.clause AS clause
FROM pcl pc
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sec s2 JOIN mods mo ON mo.section_id = s2.id JOIN docs d2 ON d2.id = mo.doc_id JOIN inpack ip ON ip.doc_id = d2.id JOIN cr_pack cp ON cp.id = ip.pack_id WHERE s2.spec = pc.spec AND s2.rel = pc.rel AND s2.clause = pc.clause AND d2.rel = pc.rel AND cp.tsg_number < pc.ptsg)

  SELECT id, id FROM document
  UNION
  SELECT number, id FROM document WHERE number IS NOT NULL
),
inpack(did, pid) AS (
  SELECT r.did, l.pack_id FROM cr_in_pack l JOIN dref r ON r.ref = l.cr
  UNION
  SELECT r.did, l.pack_id FROM pack_member l JOIN dref r ON r.ref = l.cr
),
mods(did, sid) AS (
  SELECT r.did, l.section_id FROM cr_modifies_section l JOIN dref r ON r.ref = l.cr
  UNION
  SELECT r.did, l.section_id FROM section_modified_by l JOIN dref r ON r.ref = l.cr
),
vdisp(did, code, wg_meeting) AS (
  SELECT r.did, d.code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id)
  FROM disposition d
  JOIN dref r ON r.ref = d.target
  JOIN resolution res ON res.id = d.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting m ON m.id = res.meeting_id
  WHERE replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(d.evidence_status)),'_',''),'-',''),' ','') = 'sourceverified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND (replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(m.wg)),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') IN ('RAN5','R5','RANWG5','WG5','TSGRANWG5','TSGR5') OR (m.wg IS NULL AND (replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(m.label)),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE 'RAN5%' OR replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(m.label)),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE 'R5%' OR replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(m.label)),' ',''),'_',''),'-','') LIKE 'TSGR5%')))
),
tp(pid, tnum) AS (
  SELECT id, tsg_number FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-252302' OR id = 'RP-252302'
),
base(did, dnum, spec, clause, rel, tnum) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc.id, doc.number, s.spec, s.clause, replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(s.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_',''), tp.tnum
  FROM tp
  JOIN inpack ip ON ip.pid = tp.pid
  JOIN document doc ON doc.id = ip.did
  JOIN mods mo ON mo.did = doc.id
  JOIN section s ON s.id = mo.sid
  WHERE replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(s.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_','') = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(doc.target_release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_','')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vdisp v WHERE v.did = doc.id)
),
bsec(spec, clause, rel, tnum) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT spec, clause, rel, tnum FROM base
),
hist(spec, clause, rel, btnum, pack_number, tsg_meeting, tsg_number) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bs.spec, bs.clause, bs.rel, bs.tnum, p2.pack_number, p2.tsg_meeting, p2.tsg_number
  FROM bsec bs
  JOIN section s2 ON s2.spec = bs.spec AND s2.clause = bs.clause
  JOIN mods mo2 ON mo2.sid = s2.id
  JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = mo2.did
  JOIN inpack ip2 ON ip2.did = d2.id
  JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = ip2.pid
  WHERE replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(s2.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_','') = bs.rel
    AND replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(d2.target_release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'_','') = bs.rel
    AND p2.tsg_number < bs.tnum
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.dnum AS document, b.spec AS specification, b.clause AS clause
FROM base b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM hist h
  WHERE h.spec = b.spec AND h.clause = b.clause AND h.rel = b.rel AND h.btnum = b.tnum
)

WITH
docref AS (
  SELECT id AS ref, id AS doc_id FROM document
  UNION
  SELECT number, id FROM document WHERE number IS NOT NULL
),
packref AS (
  SELECT id AS ref, id AS pack_key FROM cr_pack
  UNION
  SELECT pack_number, id FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number IS NOT NULL
),
memb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.doc_id AS doc_id, pr.pack_key AS pack_key
  FROM (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) m
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = m.cr
  JOIN packref pr ON pr.ref = m.pack_id
),
docr AS (
  SELECT id AS doc_id, COALESCE(number, id) AS doc_no, (CASE WHEN INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')>0 THEN SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),1,INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')-1) ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') END) AS rel FROM document
),
cmod AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.doc_id AS doc_id, s.spec AS spec, s.clause AS clause, d.rel AS rel
  FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) x
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = x.cr
  JOIN docr d ON d.doc_id = dr.doc_id
  JOIN section s ON s.id = x.section_id
  WHERE d.rel <> '' AND (CASE WHEN INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')>0 THEN SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),1,INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')-1) ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') END) = d.rel

  SELECT id AS ref, id AS doc_id FROM document
  UNION
  SELECT number, id FROM document WHERE number IS NOT NULL
),
packref AS (
  SELECT id AS ref, id AS pack_key FROM cr_pack
  UNION
  SELECT pack_number, id FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number IS NOT NULL
),
memb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.doc_id AS doc_id, pr.pack_key AS pack_key
  FROM (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) m
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = m.cr
  JOIN packref pr ON pr.ref = m.pack_id
),
docr AS (
  SELECT id AS doc_id, COALESCE(number, id) AS doc_no, (CASE WHEN INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')>0 THEN SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),1,INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')-1) ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(target_release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') END) AS rel FROM document
),
cmod AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.doc_id AS doc_id, s.spec AS spec, s.clause AS clause, d.rel AS rel
  FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) x
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = x.cr
  JOIN docr d ON d.doc_id = dr.doc_id
  JOIN section s ON s.id = x.section_id
  WHERE d.rel <> '' AND (CASE WHEN INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')>0 THEN SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),1,INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ',''),'.')-1) ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.release,''))),'RELEASE',''),'REL',''),'R',''),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') END) = d.rel
),
vdisp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.doc_id AS doc_id, di.code AS code, COALESCE(mt.label, mt.id) AS wg_meeting
  FROM disposition di
  JOIN docref dr ON dr.ref = di.target
  JOIN resolution rs ON rs.id = di.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting mt ON mt.id = rs.meeting_id
  WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,''))),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') IN ('sourceverified','verifiedsource','verifiedfromsource','verified')
    AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(di.scope,''))),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') IN ('wholedocument','document','whole','fulldocument','entiredocument','full','entire','doc','wholedoc','tdoc','all','wholetdoc','fulltdoc')
    AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(mt.wg,''))),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') IN ('ran3','r3','ranwg3','wg3','tsgranwg3','tsgran3','ranw3')
         OR (mt.wg IS NULL AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(mt.label,''))),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') LIKE 'ran3%' OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(mt.label,''))),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') LIKE 'r3%'
                                OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(mt.label,''))),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') LIKE 'ranwg3%')))
),
tp AS (
  SELECT id AS pack_key, tsg_number AS tn FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-233850' OR id = 'RP-233850'
),
pc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.doc_id AS doc_id, c.spec AS spec, c.clause AS clause, c.rel AS rel, tp.tn AS tn
  FROM tp
  JOIN memb mb ON mb.pack_key = tp.pack_key
  JOIN cmod c ON c.doc_id = mb.doc_id
  WHERE c.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM vdisp)
),
earlier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT k.spec AS spec, k.clause AS clause, k.rel AS rel, k.tn AS tn,
         p.tsg_number AS tsg_number, COALESCE(p.pack_number, p.id) AS pack_number, p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT spec, clause, rel, tn FROM pc) k
  JOIN cmod c ON c.spec = k.spec AND c.clause = k.clause AND c.rel = k.rel
  JOIN memb mb ON mb.doc_id = c.doc_id
  JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = mb.pack_key
  WHERE p.tsg_number < k.tn
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.spec AS specification, e.clause AS clause, e.pack_number AS cr_pack, e.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM earlier e
WHERE e.tsg_number = (
  SELECT MAX(e2.tsg_number) FROM earlier e2
  WHERE e2.spec = e.spec AND e2.clause = e.clause AND e2.rel = e.rel AND e2.tn = e.tn
)
